test_truncate_no_truncation: test the truncate function returns unchanged strings when within max_line_len and max_lines limits
test_truncate_single_line: test the truncate function truncates a single long line with ellipsis when exceeding max_line_len
test_truncate_dual_lines: test the truncate function truncates each line independently in a multi-line string
test_truncate_lines_with_generator: test the truncate_lines function accepts a generator of strings and truncates each line
test_truncate_final_line_ellipsis: test the truncate function adds ellipsis to the final line when more lines exist than max_lines
